scope: Construction eligibility and uniqueness coverage for the bundled Rome II reference catalog; not an installed-build certification.
campaign: Grand Campaign faction roster; other campaigns appearing on official detail pages are filtered from predecessor observations.
patch: Public reference snapshots have no installed-build identifier. The pinned community schema identifies fields, not game row values or patch compatibility.

unlock_and_eligibility.additional_state: Evaluate construction condition scripts/events, required technologies and resource access for the requested campaign. Public requirement lists are partial observations.

uniqueness_and_shared_caps.additional_state: Obtain actual row values and validate cap scope/semantics; identify existing and externally owned instances where applicable. A legendary name does not imply cap=1.

first_builder_rewards.additional_state: Validate acquisition conditions, duration and persistence; record which faction already earned each first-construction trait. Do not infer these rewards from recurring building effects.

regional_placement.additional_state: Resolve campaign/startpos building-set assignments and validate faction/culture variants and capital semantics. No historical place name is treated as a region restriction.

sources.quote: When your faction reaches the top of a building chain and a certain event has occurred it may then be possible to construct a legendary building. If you are the first to construct one your faction will be awarded a permanent faction trait and its associated effects.
sources.supports: Legendary buildings have event-dependent availability; first construction can award a permanent faction trait. This source does not enumerate per-building construction caps or regional restrictions.

Documents the exact construction, cap and first-in-world bundle fields listed in rule_evidence_needed. Contains no building row values; not evidence that any building has a particular cap, condition or reward.

level_five_status: Excluded from the default ordinary-level-1-through-4 economic model. A level or historical name alone does not establish a one-per-faction or region-only rule.
missing_rules: Per-building event/unlock conditions and current eligibility
Per-building or shared-chain uniqueness limits and their scope
First-construction faction-trait effect bundles and acquisition state
Installed-build validation of regional construction restrictions
